children.scope: Freeze selected feed/account/rights, schemas, event/receipt identity, sequence, seed/watermark/coverage, reconnect/gap/duplicate/late/corrected-event policy and bounded approved integration. Reuse EQ069/070 only if that provider is explicitly selected; no implicit selection of both. Current supplied-input contracts do not attest actual live completeness.

After admitted input contracts, freeze feature capability matrix, warm-up/history/reference initialization, stable per-instrument state ownership, dependency/universe barriers, bounded queues/admission/backpressure/recovery and native-thread budget policy. Preserve pure kernels and existing batch APIs; batch-only features remain explicit, with recompute/replay semantics where selected. No new scheduler framework is required by this reservation.

After selected input/orchestration contracts, select delivery transport/consumer and cadence; retain as-of/cutoff/knowledge/source identity, quality, incomplete/stale/gap status and revision/provisional/final behavior. Coalescing may affect outbound snapshots only under an explicit contract; it cannot silently discard required source events. Required correctness/receipt controls cannot be removed to claim speed.

Before performance adoption, freeze representative universe/feature mix/rates/bursts/target hardware and accepted latency/freshness/error/backlog budgets. Measure received-event-to-consumer availability p50/p95/p99 and event age only with declared clock comparability. Exercise gaps/reconnects/late corrections/overload/EOD contention, full result/quality/evidence parity, both supported platforms and actual approved integration. Synthetic replay/historical benchmark is a separate evidence level.
